title.narrative: Conservation of the Mid-19th-Century ReBonkers Bunker in Varna

description.narrative: ReBonkers, housed in a 200-year-old Ottoman gunpowder magazine in Varna, is a vital cultural center for contemporary art and community engagement, reflecting the city's rich historical and architectural heritage. The project aims to preserve the building's structural integrity, enhance its functionality for year-round use, and foster community involvement through cultural and educational events. Activities include obtaining technical documentation, conducting historical research, executing restoration work on the roof and structure, and organizing public awareness campaigns and cultural events to highlight the site's importance.

title.narrative: Conservation of the 11th-Century Church of St. Todor in Boboshevo

description.narrative: To support the conservation of the ruins of the 11th-century Church of St. Todor, a rare surviving monument of the First Bulgarian Empire (681-1018).Exposed to the elements following the recent collapse of its protective covering, the ruined church is minimally shielded by plastic tarps. This project involves the comprehensive documentation of the site, construction of a new protective cover, and the development of a site conservation plan.
